dct_description_sm: We are investigating the ecological role of anadromous Arctic char in coastal freshwater lakes. Our goal is to determine the effect that sea-run char have on food web structure (in terms of food chain length and carbon sources utilized). We are also investigating whether the presence of sea-run Arctic char impacts contaminant concentrations in other biota (e.g., lake trout, lake whitefish) through either biotransport of contaminants from the sea or effects on food web structure. Results from the project will also be used to help assess the effects of climate change on migration patterns of anadromous fishes.
dct_title_s: Climate Variability and Change (CVC) Effects on Char in the Arctic - Freshwater Food Web Data in Nunavut
